name: projected-e4e-minus12
reason: User selected the fixed -12 high-aging eyeglass correction as the direction to continue. Smooth onset preserves zero and younger edits; no age boost by default.
direction: Repeat age direction across 18 W+ layers, subtract projection onto eyeglasses boundary, restore original age direction norm.
color_preservation: Optional postprocessing only; raw outputs remain available.
limitations: Strength is not a numerical target age.
No guarantee of complete eyeglass removal on all portraits; original glasses may change.
Identity, white hair, beard and hats can still drift.
Positive aging-strength compensation can reintroduce glasses; not enabled by default.
Previously inspected development photos, not independent population validation.
